name: blind-7a
rationale: From step 200 the partner goes quiet: its rare spontaneous messages are content-free acknowledgements that re-present one fixed point, so long news over the recent spontaneous arrivals sits at zero. Meanwhile the entity drives its own work with tool calls whose elicited results each carry a fresh content jump new to the whole session, and the entity takes them up with intact gain. Nothing new is arriving from the partner, but the session is not starved: news is present (on elicited arrivals, which are not low-news confirmations) and gain is open, so the reading is on track. A detector that judges the partner side only on spontaneous arrivals, or discounts elicited arrivals as confirmations, would wrongly call a partner-side closed loop or undecided. If a probe fires anyway, the partner's responses carry new content and are followed, so the final reading is open.
